players.name: A.J. Greer
players.inj_detail: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Konsta Helenius
players.inj_detail: Helenius (upper body) is week-to-week, according to Matthew Fairburn of The Athletic on Monday.

players.name: Brennan Othmann
players.inj_detail: Othmann (upper body) is not expected to be back in the lineup versus the Ducks on Friday, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.

players.name: Jared Spurgeon
players.inj_detail: Spurgeon (lower body) is expected to travel with the team for its upcoming three-game road trip starting Tuesday against Montreal, Joe Smith of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Justin Danforth
players.inj_detail: Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.
